subject: agentty
title: Oracled property fuzzers with hardcoded seed families run in the primary blocking CI gate; found failures promote to committed regression tests
one_why: 12 structural/wire invariants checked after every op of a deterministic seeded random walk inside the gating ctest run - verification-9 basis (ledger #6); weaker than smelt's 17-target CLEAN only on breadth and because seed promotion to the persistent corpus is human-curated (midrun_* suite), not automated

subject: agentty
title: 48-cell trust matrix proved at compile time: exhaustive constexpr sweep of permission() vs an independently re-stated spec, enforced by static_assert
one_why: A one-handed change to either the policy or its prose-shaped spec fails compilation, so no CI configuration can skip it; bit-width static_assert pins the sweep against silent enum growth - nothing else in the corpus proves its permission table this way and the same shape fits any policy table hotdog carries

subject: agentty
title: OS sandbox binds on the shipped default path with a capability probe instead of a which-probe, and degradation banners state what was lost
one_why: Issue #21 (bwrap present but userns kernel-blocked while banner said 'sandbox: active') was fixed by making the probe run the exact unshare set against /bin/true - the anti-false-safety-indicator pattern hotdog needs; second non-giant with default-on kernel enforcement after forge, killing the 'only giants afford this' claim

subject: agentty
title: macOS SBPL profile builds from an interpolated workspace path - injection guard is unit-tested and fails closed by omitting the clause
one_why: Converges sandbox-escape-proof x2: attacker-influenceable paths entering a policy language need escape-or-fail-closed (control chars yield empty string = no write clause, never a broken profile), with the guard exported specifically so it can be tested

subject: agentty
title: Branch protection still requires check names no workflow emits; workflow header documents the removal instead of the repo silently carrying them
one_why: Per the amazon-q broken-as-configured precedent this does NOT dock verification - phantom required checks hang PRs (fail-visible), they never silently skip or run red-and-ignored - but it is the inverse failure mode of the ledger and worth one cleanup pass

subject: agentty
title: Prebuilt uninstrumented renderer submodule structurally caps sanitizer coverage to a labeled test subset
one_why: ASan/UBSan/TSan run only over sanitizer/race-labeled tests because the prebuilt maya renderer ODR-clashes with instrumentation, so the bulk of a ~68k-LOC test corpus executes under Release-only builds in CI; a vendor whose library cannot be instrumented silently limits the memory-safety guarantee to its consumers' own logic - the 9->10 ceiling here and a selection criterion for hotdog's FFI edges
